sample_log_lines.input:
Leiah closed unexpectedly tonight. Anyone know why?

Had reservations at Leiah tonight at 6:30. Upon arrival the front doors were locked and we then realized there were no customers inside. We waited outside confused for a couple minutes and a police officer showed up and was let in to talk with a chef. We walked away with no answers and aside from being disappointed in beyond curious. Anyone knows what's up?
sample_log_lines.label: reaction
